_comment: Known-stale evidence, waived explicitly rather than silently. .github/scripts/check_evidence_formats.py fails on any report whose recorded input hash no longer matches the committed input ('staleness is failure', klayout-tools docs/design-evidence-tiers.md). An entry here downgrades one such failure to a loud note -- and only that one: the waiver names the exact report, the exact check, and the exact stale hash. It SELF-EXPIRES: once the evidence is regenerated, the recorded_hash below no longer matches and the checker fails until the entry is deleted. Every entry must name a tracking issue. Waiving without one is a schema error, not a judgement call.

waivers.reason: Issue #579's rebase of the #571 tap-margin fix first deferred this re-mint; #561 step 2 (PR #586) then re-minted the report under the klt 0.8.0 pin on main's post-#576 GDS (the anchor recorded above), and #572's Metal1 base-contact landing -- composed into the assembly by this PR -- moves core geometry inside it again, so the committed report's input-gds anchor names main's GDS rather than the committed one. The deferral's rationale is unchanged: bandgap_top.pex.spice stays hash-pinned by the actively cited item-8 characterization report (measurements/2026-11-18-characterization-report/ pins it by hash), and re-extracting the merged GDS under the same pin would move parasitic values without changing topology (measured at core under the identical pin: total_resistance_ohm 219.26 -> 224.14, total_capacitance_ff 178.50 -> 180.71, netlist_normalized_sha256 byte-identical), churning the hash-pinned item-8 inventory for zero topological change. Waived until the PEX re-mint tracked in #278/#275 lands; the entry self-expires when pex_extract_report.json is regenerated against the merged GDS.
